description: This file defines structures, constants, and function prototypes for accessing embedded resource forks in files, specifically within the FreeType project. It includes resource reference structures, guessing rules for resource locations, and functions to retrieve header info and data offsets in resource forks.

methods.name: FT_Raccess_Guess
methods.description: Guesses the file name and offset where the resource fork is stored, using multiple rules.

methods.name: FT_Raccess_Get_HeaderInfo
methods.description: Retrieves header information from a resource fork, including map and data start offsets.

methods.name: FT_Raccess_Get_DataOffsets
methods.description: Gets data offsets for a specific resource tag within a resource fork.
